description: This Java source file contains an integration test class TelemetryMqttQoS1IT that tests uploading telemetry data via MQTT with QoS 1 to an MQTT adapter. It extends a base test class and overrides methods for sending messages and creating consumers, utilizing the Vert.x framework and MQTT protocol.
